title: concert venue and/or movie theater: have you been here?
content: What's up you warlocks, I cannot stop having dreams in this place, so here's how they have been recently. They're a little different now. I have a previous post here. [link](https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/16d12x2/me_and_my_sister_have_had_mallworld_dreams_for/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3) Have any of you seen a huge, grand movie theater? It's a dome type structure, at least from the inside, with beautiful gold/bronze/yellow architecture. I can't remember ever actually seeing a play in this place, the dream just uses it as a.. jumping off point? Now, sometimes, the 'show' is at a cool little concert venue in the middle of the *Night City* downtown place. It's full of socializing and interesting people. I'm an attendee for a fancy concert/show or theater performance at least once a week in my dreams. The first time I saw the large theater, it was from the outside. I was down at least two hundred yards from it. The building was sitting across from me on a long walkway like the Washington monument. Two people that I couldn't identify opened the double doors for me. I rocketed into the theater nearly against my will. I landed in the theater, facing the stage, and the dream suddenly changed. I was a different girl, talking to a friend on the street. I immediately understood that I was in the wrong body, somehow, and began to panic that I could never go back to my mind's real body and I would never see my family again. My friend had a red shirt and brown hair. She was really worried and was asking if I was okay. I wasn't. The dream lasted all of five seconds. We were on a semi-country road, talking near the opened trunk of an SUV. Then I woke up. I've never even seen a god damn play at this place. It's literally anxiety inducing to realize I am there now. &#x200B;
